structure.unit: Prisons and Other Methods of Correction

law.catch_line: Consideration of report developed at diagnostic facilities
law.text: The Department shall give careful consideration to the report developed at the diagnostic facilities established under § 53.1-64 in determining whether persons committed to it under the provisions of § 19.2-311 et seq., are to be confined at a youthful offender facility or elsewhere in the state corrections system.
